children: Eight financial institutions, including Agricultural Bank of China (1288), Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (1398), China Life Group, PICC (1339), China Taiping Insurance, China Exim Bank, China Export & Credit Insurance, and China Reinsurance, have each received capital injections from the Ministry of Finance and other parties, with the total amount currently standing at RMB 360 billion, according to Ming Pao.

title: Eight Chinese Financial Institutions Receive RMB 360 Billion Capital Injection
